Basis Traffic Data
The air terminal facilities at General Mitchell Field are accessible from Howell Avenue with entrance roadways consisting of a one way pair for passenger vehicles and a two way service road for truck traffic. These roadways are located approximately 1400, 1600, and 2000 feet north of Grange Avenue respectively.
